brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine whether in patients with early type 2 diabetes, a short-term intensive metabolic intervention comprising iGlarLixi, metformin, and lifestyle approaches will be superior to standard diabetes therapy in achieving sustained diabetes remission.
brief_title: Remission Evaluation of a Metabolic Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes With IGlarLixi
official_title: Remission Evaluation of a Metabolic Intervention for Type 2 Diabetes With IGlarLixi

primary_outcomes.measure: The first occurrence of diabetes relapse
